title: German Skillet Squash
description: A hearty German-inspired dish featuring roasted squash, mediterranean flavors, and a crispy skillet finish.
instructions: 2. Toss squash cubes with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
3. In a large skillet, heat remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium-high heat.
4. Add roasted squash to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
5. Stir in Mediterranean roasted red pepper hummus and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
6. Serve squash mixture over garlic bread and garnish with chopped parsley.
